verdict.rationale: Deel documents an official MCP server that exposes payroll data to Claude, ChatGPT, or custom agents, with tools mapped to API operations that return JSON. That gives an agent a plausible route to pull payroll data. However, nothing in the evidence shows payroll journal or general-ledger entries, an accounting export, or any ledger sync or reconciliation workflow. Missing for 10: a documented payroll journal/GL report endpoint or export, accounting-system integrations for posting entries, reconciliation tooling, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
